author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Both 8BitDo and GameSir have released vertical phone controllers this year, so let's compare them.

8BitDo FlipPad: https://amzn.to/4x3fjuC
8BitDo direct: https://shop.8bitdo.com/products/flippad
GameSir Pocket Taco: https://amzn.to/4xpd2uf
GameSir direct: https://gamesir.com/products/gamesir-pocket-taco

My iPhone Case: https://amzn.to/4vKkiPP
Pocket Taco landscape extension: https://makerworld.com/en/models/2968465-pocket-taco-landscape-extension#profileId-3328783
iPhone RetroArch guide: https://youtu.be/DHlJ3zANcjo
iPhone Delta guide: https://youtu.be/uQkodIYsb8c
IINE Mini controller: https://amzn.to/4bK3BNk

Both controllers were review units sent to me by the manufacturer for testing and feedback.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this video ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
